HediffDef.label: Slow Regeneration
HediffDef.description: This creature's metabolism has been altered by a fleshshaper, granting them a slow regenerative capability.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: This creature's metabolism has been altered by a fleshshaper, granting them a slow regenerative capability.

HediffDef.label: Rapid Regeneration
HediffDef.description: This creature's metabolism has been altered by an absorbed fleshmass heart, granting them a fast but temporary regenerative capability.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: This creature's metabolism has been altered by an absorbed fleshmass heart, granting them a fast but temporary regenerative capability.

HediffDef.label: Anomalous Sustenance
HediffDef.description: This creature possesses a fleshmass meat node within their body, this node transforms ambient psychic energy present in the world into nutrients. Effectively negating this creature's need to eat.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: This creature possesses a fleshmass meat node within their body, this node transforms ambient psychic energy present in the world into nutrients. Effectively negating this creature's need to eat.
